issues.description: extract_arch_from_url can return None and caller stuffs literal 'None' into the URL path
issues.detail: When the arch regex misses, the function returns None and use_koji_url_only interpolates it into '/latest/None/Packages/...', producing a silently broken lockfile entry that 404s at build time. Either raise on no-match or have the caller check and fail loudly rather than emitting garbage URLs.

issues.description: nevra[0].lower() shards on first character of filename without stating the invariant
issues.detail: The koji path uses /Packages/<first-letter-of-name>/<nevra>, but the code takes the first character of the full filename. It happens to work for lowercase-letter names but breaks on digits or uppercase, and nothing documents or enforces the contract. Parse the package name properly or assert the invariant.

issues.description: Acknowledged race between URL construction and coreos-koji-tagger has no mitigation
issues.detail: The commit message admits the crafted URL may not exist yet because the tagger hasn't moved the build into coreos-pool. There is no retry, no HEAD verification, no logging of constructed URLs. At minimum log what gets crafted so the inevitable failures are debuggable; ideally verify or gate on tag completion.

issues.description: Hardcoded arch list and koji base URL duplicate knowledge with no single source of truth
issues.detail: The arch allowlist ['x86_64','aarch64','ppc64le','s390x'] and the koji base URL are embedded inside helpers, while 'coreos-pool' appears as a substring check elsewhere in the same file. Lift these to module-level constants so adding an arch or changing the pool host is a one-line change in one place.

issues.description: use_koji_url_only complects URL detection, NEVRA parsing, arch extraction, and path templating
issues.detail: The function braids multiple concerns into one body and reaches into a filename string as if it were structured data. Extract parse_nevra() returning (name, ver, rel, arch) and a pure render_koji_url(value), then map over inputs. The intent becomes visible and the first-letter shard becomes name[0].lower() instead of an incidental string trick.

issues.description: Old coreos-pool prioritization in query_packages_location is now dead weight
issues.detail: Since every URL is rewritten to coreos-pool form afterward, the 'prefer coreos-pool' branch in query_packages_location no longer affects the output. Either remove the redundant layer or document why both mechanisms coexist; two overlapping mechanisms will confuse the next maintainer.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the patch is a reasonable workaround for a DNF5 baseurl bug but ships with sloppy execution. Two P0 defects dominate: extract_arch_from_url silently returns None and gets interpolated into a broken URL, and nevra[0].lower() shards on the first character of a filename rather than the parsed package name, with no documented invariant. The acknowledged race with coreos-koji-tagger is left entirely unmitigated, and hardcoded arch/URL constants and a complected helper add avoidable risk. NEEDS-WORK before merge: fix the None path, parse NEVRA properly, log constructed URLs, and consolidate constants.
